programmes.d: Scientists use robotic creations for competition; two robots from competing camps fall in love.
Led by a clue given by a robot Dr. Elephant assembled, Astro Boy heads to Antarctica with Daddy Walrus to investigate the gang of Black Looks and beat them off.
Medabee trains Cyandog to battle kindergarteners.
Ikki enters Metabee in the city's Robattle tournament.
Koji and Sumilidon defeat Metabee but think Ikki threw the match.
A tabloid reporter suspects Ikki is the Phantom Renegade.
Mia and Anubis try to puzzle out how to use the Jewel of Life to defeat Anubis while Ryo and Rowan encounter traps in the Nether World.
Rowan sacrifices himself to help Ryo and the others fend off Lady Kayura; Badamon and Talpa realize the heroes now possess the means to destroy them.
The warlords separate the heroes once again when they force Ryo, Cye and Kento to fall into a chasm; Sage and Rowen defend Mia and Ully, who possess the Jewel of Life, from Talpa's minions.
The heroes take a much-needed rest to prepare for the final showdown with Talpa; as Lady Kayura's memories resurface, Badamon and Talpa scheme to keep her under control.
As Talpa's plan to harness the power of the nine armors comes to fruition, Anubis battles a possessed Lady Kayura in the hopes of freeing her from the bonds of evil.
Lady Kayura and the warlords fight alongside the heroes to defeat Talpa before the solar eclipse triggers the destruction of the mortal world.

Conan, Jimsy, and Lana reunite with Dyce on the Barracuda; meanwhile Dr. Lao must return to Industria to help save its residents.
Conan, Jimsy, and Lana explore High Harbor and meet the villagers but Jimsy can't help but get into mischief.
Conan and Jimsy must catch a wild pig in order to redeem themselves with Orlo, the leader of a local gang.
Lana has a nightmarish vision that Dr. Lao's flying machine is engulfed in flames and fears an attack; Conan does his best to try and ease her worries.
When Industria soldiers reach High Harbor, the villagers must band together to defend their home.
Conan and Lana try to evade Industria's soldiers, but Lana is captured.

Leo is convinced that there's a ghostly website out there on the internet and is determined to find it, which he does; trapped in the computer, the rest of the gang needs to figure out how to apply old-fashioned exorcism to new technologies.

There's a girl in Satsuki's class who is a little off; she tends to the rabbits at the school, whom she says are her only friends. But if that's weird, then it gets only stranger when a dead rabbit shows back up at the pen, alive and well.

Hajime has a close encounter with a spooky cab, which the rest of the gang doesn't believe; even when they see it for themselves, it seems like a perfectly normal cab, that is until the cab driver takes them to a life-draining tunnel.

The gang finds a strange doll in the trash; Satsuki prevents Keiichiro from bringing the doll home, but it shows up regardless; late at night, Satsuki gets a phone call from none other than the doll herself.
The guerrillas might need a great deal of convincing to provide support to the Radorio mother ship.
Hazard ruins Joe's chances of establishing cordial relations with the guerrillas.
Joe alights the Radorio mother ship to buy enough time for it to get away from Grathan.
Joe expects help from the Earth Federation Forces to get himself and the others out of Phobos.
While swimming on the ocean floor, Ataru and Mendou find a woman in search of her missing child; a woman who just may be Ryuunosuke's long-lost mother.
The glow of a mysterious lantern appears to be attracting Ataru like a moth to the flame.
While relaxing at Mendou's seaside resort, the gang run into the friendly pool goblin again; after they catch up, the gang agrees to help him win the hand of a lovely lady.
Ran loses a piece of crystallized supernova, and it's up to the gang to find it before the entire planet burns to a crisp.
Ippo trains with Aoki to counter Hayami's Shotgun punch.
The Ippo vs. Hayami fight begins.
Ippo hopes his training with Aoki and Kimura will help him win the match.
Miyata and Mashiba face off.
Cleopatra is resurrected before her Egyptian public, but a robot Caesar steals the sign of the queen and passes it off to Astro.
Astro rescues Goliath, a mining robot from Mars, from a burning wreck.
Atlas gets falsely accused of destroying space stations; Livian begs Astro not to fight Atlas.
Astro untangles the mystery of balloons modeled after him.
A power-hungry Sultan commissions a powerful robot to battle seven of the world's strongest robots; to make Astro fight, the Sultan holds Dr. Elefun hostage.
